exposure: Gestational age at delivery (39 weeks, 40 weeks, 41 weeks)
Birth weight percentile (<10th percentile (SGA), >90th percentile (LGA), 10-90th percentile (AGA))
cohort: 8.9 million low-risk women with nonanomalous cephalic singleton gestations who labored and delivered at 39 to 41 weeks in the US from 2013-2017
finding: The risks of composite neonatal and maternal adverse outcomes increase from 39 through 41 weeks' gestation, irrespective of whether newborns are small for gestational age (SGA), large for gestational age (LGA), or appropriate for gestational age (AGA).
birth_weight: Categorized as <10th percentile (SGA), 10-90th percentile (AGA), and >90th percentile (LGA)
